sh's execv path rejects the 94 MB flat CLANG.BIN at the kernel's MAX_PROGRAM_SIZE = 1 MiB exec gate (src/include/process.h:42; src/kernel/program_loader.c program_too_large -> -ENOEXEC) — w4-src's CLANG-EXEC-1MIB-GATE, still present in the merged tip, kernel-side, owner w5-kernel (raise/remove to USER_IMG_SIZE)
this is NOT the nothrow wall: the exec gate fires before clang's first instruction.  The _Znwm/nothrow wall (lane w5-nothrow) is DOWNSTREAM — clang must execute to reach codegen
contrast with the version gate: the driver's scheduler spawn of the SAME flat CLANG.BIN runs fine (94 MB loaded + prefetched + banner); only the execv path carries the 1 MiB gate

implementation.elf_flat: converts one ELF to a flat image via host llvm-objcopy -O binary with sanity checks: 64-bit AArch64 ELF magic/class/machine detection (return 1 = already flat -> copy verbatim), e_entry == USER_IMG_BASE (0x1000000000) [return 2 = abort staging], first PT_LOAD p_vaddr == e_entry [return 2], flat[0:64] == ELF first-LOAD file content [return 2].  Any return-2 aborts the staging so a broken toolchain can never land silently.
implementation.stage_flat: per-tool wrapper: convert-if-ELF then mcopy -o to the frozen /TOOLS name; already-flat sources are cp'd (skip cleanly); recorded sizes/bytes are the FLAT sizes
implementation.idempotence: -f replaces ::/TOOLS via mdeltree first; without -f mcopy -o overwrites in place.  Re-runs green (verified on scratch image + inside the real disk.img run).
implementation.host_dep: llvm-objcopy checked only when an ELF is found; absent dist-staging still warns+skips (soft dependency preserved)
